subject: reasoning
question: Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the South. He then takes a right turn, drives 21 km, then turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 23 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94577c3b15891fb1b4d75099ce3ac298872961ee568dee200bd0ff97d6374b5a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/826208f5e25c2428efee0e2318986c31d8e468cff3749b44c510be7798c38dde.png] 

To reach point A again, he should drive 23 - 21 = **2 km in West **direction.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
